profile.name: Wattanaroj Butdee
profile.headline: Software Engineer Intern | Full-Stack Dev
about: Fourth-year Data Science and Software Innovation student building FallHelp, a wearable IoT system for fall detection and caregiver alerts.
I work across embedded hardware, real-time backend services, databases, and mobile experiences to turn sensor data into useful safety workflows.

research.narrative: FallHelp is my senior project: a neck-worn ESP32 device detects possible falls, captures heart rate at the event, and connects to a caregiver application through MQTT, a backend API, PostgreSQL, Socket.IO, and Expo Push Notifications.

focus.name: Wearable Fall Detection
focus.description: Threshold-based analysis of accelerometer and gyroscope data on an ESP32 device.

focus.name: Real-Time Caregiver Alerts
focus.description: MQTT and Socket.IO event flows for confirmed falls, notifications, and alert acknowledgement.

focus.name: Caregiver Mobile Experience
focus.description: React Native and Expo dashboard for fall history, alerts, reports, and emergency contact actions.

focus.name: End-to-End Integration
focus.description: Connecting firmware, backend API, PostgreSQL, push notifications, and admin operations.

projects.name: FallHelp
projects.summary: A senior-project prototype combining a neck-worn ESP32 fall detector, heart-rate capture, caregiver mobile app, backend API, and real-time alerts.

footer: FallHelp — turning wearable sensor data into faster caregiver response.
